[[q1q3monsoon]] was created by {{player|Mick|flag=dk}} as part of [http://www.quakeworld.nu/forum/topic/6152 ProjectQ1Q3]. Some playtesting has led to an alternative version that is a candidate for inclusion in [[Thunderdome_Season_9|Thunderdome 9]]'s mappool.
